headerDisplay: Control your Sony VPL-XW5000ES projector using ADCP over IP.

ip.title: Projector IP Address
ip.description: The static IP address assigned to your projector.

adcpPort.title: ADCP Port
adcpPort.description: Port number for ADCP communication (default is 53595).

useAuth.title: Use Authentication
useAuth.description: Enable if your projector requires authentication.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: The timeout for commands and connections, in seconds.

logging.title: Logging Level
logging.description: Set the logging level. Options are 'none' (no logging), 'standard' (basic logging), 'debug' (detailed logging for troubleshooting).
